svg.title: Surface fractions and the SABRE N₂O₅ uptake contrast
svg.desc: The fitted small mode supplies 63.3–67.5% of modeled wet area across eight groups of SABRE air. At fixed reaction probabilities for the two particle populations, shifting their surface fractions permits at most a 1.13-fold spread in effective uptake probability. Preliminary field-inferred values span 11.2-fold. The ratios share a log scale beginning at one. Matching is by flight date and nitrous oxide tracer group.
